title: Supply Chain Attack on safe-agent-rs
technical_mechanism: -- # `safe-agent-rs` was removed from crates.io for being affiliated with malicious code While `safe-agent-rs` did not directly contain malicious code; it was owned by the same user as `pretty-changelog-logger` and `microsoftsystem64`. `safe-agent-rs` also appeared to be imitating a different websocket
